tha-ap143:1.1: Sobhitavaggo cuddasamo. [141. Adhicchattiya.] Parinibbute bhagavati Atthadassi-naruttame / chattādhichattaṃ karetvā thūpamhi abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap143:2.1: Kālena kālaṃ āgantvā namassiṃ lokanāyakaṃ / pupphacchadanaṃ katvāna chattamhi abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap143:3.1: Sattarase kappasate devarajjam akārayiṃ. / manussattaṃ na gacchāmi thūpapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap143:5.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Adhicchattiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Adhicchatiyattherassa
